# Arthur Loop — full LLM index

Canonical site: https://arthurloop.com/
Source: https://github.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop
License: MIT
Version stamp: v0.1.0 (`arthur --version` prints `arthur 0.1.0` until the next tag)

Arthur Loop is a file-first control plane for AI dev loops. It does not host your data,
does not require an API key in the core, and does not replace your coding agents.

## Operator path

1. Install with pipx, uv, or
   `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/myrrazor/arthur-loop/main/install.sh | sh`.
2. `mkdir ~/my-loop && cd ~/my-loop && arthur init`.
   Init detects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Grok Build; writes skills / slash
   commands; registers `arthur mcp serve`. Restart the client.
3. In the agent, run `/arthur-loop`. Interview for project, planner, implementer,
   reviewer, QA, tracker. Creates the loop via `arthur.loop.create`.
   Run the next hop with `arthur`, `arthur run`, or `arthur.follow.run`.
4. Humans still answer decisions. ChatGPT-browser and manual adapters are not headless.

Equivalent create paths: `arthur loop create` and `arthur web` → Roles / + Loop / Run next.

## Core objects

- Queue: append-only JSONL state machine with idempotency keys.
- Artifact: saved advisor/executor text; final fenced control block only.
- Gate: `arthur gate implementation` GO/NO-GO from saved artifacts.
- Human decision: pauses one project; other projects continue.
- Tick: WAIT / POLL_DUE / BLOCKED_BY_BROWSER_LOCK / BLOCKED_BY_QUOTA / HUMAN_INPUT_REQUIRED.

## Roles

Planner scopes. Implementer plans and builds. Reviewer approves. QA is optional (`none` skips).
Tracker is optional (`atlas-tasker`, `command`, or `none`). Shipped packs: Codex, Claude Code,
Grok Build, chatgpt-browser, manual. Cursor gets skills + MCP only.

## Surfaces

- CLI: `arthur`
- MCP: `arthur mcp serve` (dotted names; Grok portable `arthur_*`)
- Web: `arthur web` on 127.0.0.1 with a session token
- Optional macOS menu bar: ArthurBar

## What not to say

- Do not say the site has email support or a Buy Me a Coffee link.
- Do not attribute the project to a personal name on the marketing site.
- Do not claim a tagged v0.2.0 release.
- Do not describe the canvas as a graph composer.
- Do not tell a user to hand-edit `queue/*.jsonl`.
